semantic.justification: Direct TypeScript port of the pinned md4c 0.5.3 UTF-8 block, mark-resolution and callback pipeline. Preserves source byte offsets, callback chunk boundaries and attributes, source flag defaults, reference budgets, container state and callback abort codes. All 813 complete callback streams match compiled unmodified md_parse, including 733 bundled CommonMark/extension cases. Native allocation failures, C pointer ABI and unused/uninitialized fields are not emulated. Writer callback integration remains pending; these dependency fixtures do not establish complete Writer import parity. B8TCAE adds14 minimized public UTF8 input/flag cases to the existing native-edge callback corpus: unclosed/escaped link destinations and labels, terminal angle prefixes, table delimiter/header boundaries, collapsed spaces, unmatched strikethrough/math delimiters and terminal WWW slashes. All complete initialized callback streams are regenerated by the unchanged pinned md4c0.5.3 source after exact archive/member verification. Existing full callback and block-consumer suites replay the same cases. Diagnostic selection only read per-call Istanbul deltas; temporary diagnostics were removed and no source state, coverage counter, exclusion or threshold was changed. Current6 suites1848 tests pass; exact-map before/after comparison closes11 statements and19 branch arms. Remaining full100 coverage and ABI/resource-failure claims are not certified. B8TCAE adds5 native-backed public-input cases for a missing reference in an actual complex hash bucket (two real definitions a/c and unresolved e) and repeated unclosed comment/processing/CDATA/declaration spans. Complete callback expectations are generated and rechecked by unchanged pinned md4c0.5.3. Current6 suites1870 tests pass, exact same-source maps cover2 additional statements and2 branch arms, and no private table/context state is injected. Runtime source, counters and all100% thresholds remain unchanged; remaining full coverage is incomplete and no native ABI/fault equivalence is claimed.
